query:
UPDATE grading_runs
            SET status = $2, score = $3, total = $4, results = $5::text::jsonb, problems = $6,
                error = $7, log_tail = $8, changes = $9::text::jsonb, notify = $10,
                error_kind = $11, finished_at = now()
          WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'grading'
